subject.title: fix(config): improve validation error messages with line numbers, bracket paths, and received values

question: Should line-number diagnostics ship with this custom best-effort JSON5 navigator, or must source locations come from a parser-backed implementation before merge?
rationale: The PR proves the desired UX, but the permanent ownership boundary between the canonical JSON5 parser and a second partial scanner is an architectural choice automation cannot safely settle.

options.title: Require parser-backed locations
options.body: Rework source lookup onto the canonical parser or a maintained JSON5 AST/location library while retaining display-only bracket formatting and redacted values.

options.title: Accept bounded best effort
options.body: Keep the scanner but document and test its supported JSON5 subset and graceful-degradation behavior before merge.

options.title: Land bracket formatting first
options.body: Use the narrower proven bracket-only PR and track line and value enrichment as separate work.

recommendation.title: Require parser-backed locations
recommendation.body: Rework source lookup onto the canonical parser or a maintained JSON5 AST/location library while retaining display-only bracket formatting and redacted values.

likelyOwner.reason: The decision most directly affects the config snapshot and parser ownership boundary associated with recent config I/O work.
